global_revision_rules: Conflicting target-architecture artifacts become STALE_RECHECK_REQUIRED or SUPERSEDED; never silently reinterpret them.
Model-visible target leakage makes a generator BLOCKED even when class balance or marginal MI is good.
Pre-universal-frame cognitive rows remain donor/retrofit material until model-visible H_before/H_after semantics pass the current gate.
Evidence-bearing Hyperposition rows must preserve evidence identity, provenance/ancestry and independence group; repeated packaging is not independent evidence.
Coupled alternatives require explicit joint compatibility; implicit Cartesian completion is forbidden.
Training execution, accepted dataset tokens and model/runtime credit remain separate from source/data-design status.
